hypothesis: R266 的 A 腿在当前数据上有正收益和可承受回撤，但收益由少数股票贡献。保持信号、候选排序、持有期、成本和历史成分不变，仅将同时持仓上限从 10 提至 20；若扩大的持仓容量能提高覆盖股票数、通过集中度上限，并保留至少 70% 的 10 仓全样本收益，则该配置进入纸面观察研究。

gates.P1: 10-position control curve loaded for comparison is byte-identical to the finalized R266 3x curve cache; R266 parity gate passed
gates.P2: strategy is present in the running panel, referenced factors are present, and strategy load errors are zero
gates.G1: candidate full-sample 3x return > 0 and >= 70% of R266 10-position return
gates.G2: candidate full-sample MDD is no worse than -25%
gates.D1: candidate trades at least 70 distinct symbols, versus 59 in R266
gates.C2: largest symbol share of net P&L <= 25%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols with positive validation P&L
gates.C6: largest industry share of gross profit <= 45%
gates.C7: largest single-symbol loss <= 20% of gross profit

decision_rule: P/G/D/C 全部通过才进入纸面观察研究；任一失败均不采纳。读取结果后不得修改持仓上限、成本、窗口、宇宙或门槛。
known_limitations: The comparison is one strategy capacity configuration and does not isolate future market regimes.
Discovery/validation split is not fully independent; the strategy has been used in prior research.
Industry classification is the current snapshot.
The strategy holds up to 35 trading days and has no fixed stop loss.
A panel registration check does not constitute production approval.
